scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducibility are supplied in the package. Finite checks are not substituted for all-parameter or asymptotic proof. The known Gaussian joint-diagonalization algorithm, objective, high-probability bounds, and restart principle are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The conclusions are a sharp benchmark for one explicit pair of 2x2 symmetric matrices, not a guarantee for arbitrary nearly commuting families.
Loss is joint squared Frobenius offdiagonality, not an eigenvector forward error or an implementation runtime.
Limits are taken with fixed trial count and exact arithmetic; neither finite-precision stability nor complex or non-Gaussian trials is addressed.
Originality is a best-knowledge literature comparison; independent priority validation remains open.
scientific_scope: Exact real orthogonal random-combination joint diagonalization for the two matrices diag(1,-1) and epsilon times the coordinate swap, with 0<epsilon<1 and a fixed positive integer number of independent standard Gaussian trials.
title: Three Gaussian trials remove the mean-square logarithmic barrier in randomized joint diagonalization
